input.text:
Hmm, I actually don't have a way to look up customer MRR data from here — this channel isn't connected to a CRM data source I can query.

content.text: I've responded to Mike. To be transparent about my reasoning: I'm a coding agent running in a development environment — I don't have access to a live CRM, billing system, or customer database where MRR figures would be stored. Rather than search pointlessly or, worse, fabricate a number, I flagged that someone with dashboard access needs to pull the real figure.
